_comment: Asserted by adapters/railgun/scripts/check-sdk-test-count.sh: a test file that
silently stops being collected (rename, bad include glob, a describe left as
.skip) turns the sdk-tests lane green with less running -- this file is what
catches the number drifting. Every count is EXACT: a floor on `passed` lets a new test
cover for a deleted one, so any change to it is a deliberate bump reviewed with its diff.
The 6 skipped tests / 2 skipped files are the intentionally env-gated live and bench tier:
live_latency_bench.test.ts (1) and poseidon_throughput_bench.test.ts (1); CI sets none of their run env vars.
pin_resolver_live.test.ts skips 3 without RAVEN_PIN_UPSTREAM and runs its 1 offline fold, and
live_ppoi_smoke.test.ts skips 1 without RAVEN_LIVE_URL + RAVEN_PIN_UPSTREAM and runs 26 against an
in-process node and aggregator, so neither is a skipped file.
Anything else skipped is a regression, not a policy.
